headline: Paraguay Bond Spreads Rise Following Ueno Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguay's sovereign bond spread rose above 140 points following the failure of Ueno Bank, which has over 3 million clients, prompting phased deposit repayments and state pension assurances.
why: Bank failures in emerging markets can trigger sharp increases in sovereign risk premiums and require state interventions to protect depositors and pension systems.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: The collapse of a major domestic bank led to rising bond spreads and systemic credit concerns.
